agent_discovery.description: Preview a relative end-effector translation, bounded controlled-frame yaw, or both from the measured pose. Activate robot_arm.rebot_dm before robot_arm.primary.integrated. World language uses +X front, +Y left, +Z up; explicit world axes require a reviewed transform, while raw arm axes use ARM_BASE_POSITIVE_* names. PRESERVE_MEASURED_CONTROLLED_FRAME retains measured POSE_6DOF orientation. APPLY_CONTROLLED_FRAME_YAW_DELTA composes intrinsic yaw about controlled +Z: positive turns left, negative turns right, and magnitude is limited to 45 degrees. Rotation-only uses direction NONE and distance_m 0. requested_speed_m_s is nominal, not constant Cartesian speed; Provider safety may lengthen duration. Visual evidence is best-effort. On PREVIEW_READY, call required_next_tool unchanged.
when_to_use: The operator requests a new relative Cartesian end-effector translation, controlled-frame head yaw, or combined pose change.
The Basic and Integrated arm Providers can be activated in dependency order.
A fresh measured controlled-frame pose is available.
Optional fixed-rig visual evidence may be collected when available.
when_not_to_use: The request is safe-home, gravity float, emergency stop, or raw joint control.
The collision scene or required controller state is unavailable and the operator does not accept that limitation.
The requested semantic direction cannot be resolved from an operator-confirmed mount or a measured transform.
side_effects: May require approval-gated activation of the Basic and Integrated arm Providers.
After fixed-rig confirmation, may non-destructively start or verify camera and VIO tracking without resetting the epoch.
May capture best-effort gravity-aligned effector evidence before and after an approved move.
Stages a nonphysical Integrated Controller target and preview.
Does not itself authorize or execute physical motion.

reference_frame.description: WORLD is required for ordinary unqualified 3D language and explicit signed world axes. Explicit signed world axes require a reviewed motion-usable world-to-arm transform and cannot use the upright arm fallback. CAMERA_LEVEL is only for explicit gravity-leveled camera-relative 3D language. ARM_BASE is only for explicit ARM_BASE signed-axis commands.

arm_mount_assumption.description: Use CONFIRMED_X_FORWARD_Z_UP only after the operator explicitly confirms base +Z opposite gravity and base +X along workcell front.

camera_level_assumption.description: Use CONFIRMED_GRAVITY_LEVELED only after the operator confirms that camera front/left/right ignore pitch and roll and up is opposite gravity.

fixed_vio_rig_assumption.description: Use CONFIRMED_FIXED_STATIONARY_RIG only after the operator confirms the camera and IMU are rigidly fixed together and can remain stationary for VIO checking and before/after visual evidence.

orientation_policy.description: Use PRESERVE_MEASURED_CONTROLLED_FRAME when the operator asks to keep the effector head, pointing direction, attitude, or full 3D orientation during translation. Use APPLY_CONTROLLED_FRAME_YAW_DELTA for a bounded intrinsic turn about the measured controlled-frame +Z axis. Both policies bind an exact POSE_6DOF target.

controlled_frame_yaw_delta_deg.description: Required and nonzero only for APPLY_CONTROLLED_FRAME_YAW_DELTA. This is intrinsic yaw about the measured controlled +Z axis: positive turns controlled +X toward +Y (left), and negative turns it toward -Y (right).

distance_m.description: Translation distance. Use exactly 0 with direction NONE for rotation-only motion; positive translations must be from 0.001 to 0.2 m.

requested_speed_m_s.description: Optional nominal average endpoint speed. The adapter requests distance_m / requested_speed_m_s seconds; the Provider may lengthen the trajectory for joint-rate safety. This is not constant instantaneous Cartesian velocity.

provider_activation_sequence.reason: Owns the hardware, joint feedback, gravity float, and fenced operational control.
Owns Cartesian IK preview and one-shot motion execution.
